description: CN+: Vehicular Dataset at Traffic Light Regulated Intersection in Bremen, Germany is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Thenuka Karunathilake et al. Vehicular Ad-Hoc Networks (VANETs) were introduced to avoid vehicular-related accidents and to improve the safety of both vehicular passengers and other road users. In VANETs, the vehicles are expected to communicate with neighbouring vehicles to increase awareness about the surrounding by using V2V (vehicle-to-vehicle) communication links. Coverage: national (DE); published in 2024. Formats: CSV, Image. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
